newsitem.title: LATVIA: LODE BRICK MAKER SAYS 1Q PROFIT 66,282 LATS.
newsitem.headline: LODE BRICK MAKER SAYS 1Q PROFIT 66,282 LATS.

text.p: Latvian brick maker Lode said on Friday that its first quarter profit came to 66,282 lats and that it now expected a better result for 1997 than it had originally planned.
"Our first quarter profit is 66,282 lats against a loss for the same period in 1996," Janis Slesars, the company's president, told Reuters.
He added that the figures were not comparable because the company changed its methods of calculation in the middle of last year.
Slesars said that Lode's sales were up 181 percent to 269,155 lats in the first three months of this year compared to the correspodning period last year.
He also said that the company had revised its forecast for 1997 and that it expected a before tax profit of 400,000 lats, up from the previous forecast.
Lode is an active scondary list share on the Riga bourse and its price on Friday slipped slightly to 2.45 lats from 2.50 lats.
